commands.name: generate
commands.description: create a new Component in the current solution

commands.name: help
commands.description: Shows a list of commands or help for one command

commands.name: new
commands.description: create a new solution in the current directory

commands.name: ui
commands.description: Launch the local MMA CLI Studio visual schema designer and code generator.

options.name: --port
options.description: Loopback port to listen on (default: 5080; use 0 for auto-pick)

options.name: --path
options.description: Open or import the solution at <dir> automatically

options.name: --no-browser
options.description: Do not automatically open the default browser

options.name: --mapper
options.description:
Select the mapper package (allowed packages are Mapster | AutoMapper, default: AutoMapper)
generate, g:
entity, e     To indicate scaffolding of an entity, enter Entity name and Id type (default: Guid)
property, p   To indicate scaffolding of a property, enter Entity name, Property name, Property datatype. To remove, add --remove flag
relation, r   To indicate scaffolding of a relation, enter reference Entity name, child Entity name, ForeignKey datatype. To remove, add --remove flag
